the RV305 study showed that the RV144 vaccine regimen boosted the B cell repertoire with an increase in the number of Env bs-specific memory B cells with longer VH3 CDR3s, but did not induce plasma bnAbs.

RV305 boosts with AIDSVax BE gp120, ALVAC, or both expanded a novel pool neutralizing Env CD4bs B cell clonal repertoires that are distinct from the RV144 post-boost B cells, with a subset having long VH HCDR3 and neutralizing CNE8.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have found that boosting with a gp120 protein vaccine can increase the number of memory B cells that are capable of neutralizing HIV-1.
we have shown that the RV144 vaccine boosts induced neutralizing B cell lineages that were not induced by the RV144 prime.
we show that the HIV-1 RV144 vaccine boosted a pool of Env CD4 bs-reactive memory B cells whose germline precursor B cells and affinity matured members neutralized HIV-1 tier 2 primary isolates.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the RV144 HIV vaccine boosted a novel pool of Env CD4bs-reactive memory B cells that had long VH3 HCDR3s, whose germline precursor B cells were capable of neutralizing HIV-1 CRFO1AE.CNE8.
we have shown that the RV305 HIV vaccine boosts expanded neutralizing antibody B cell clonal lines that are likely to be precursors of bnAbs.

the RV305 trial boosted a pool of Env-specific memory B cells with HCDR3s that are longer than those of most HIV-1 bnAbs, and that the germline precursers and affinity matured members of these B cell clonal families neutralized the CNE8 primary isolate.
